Every field below is read out of the attested bundle except source.repo, which the submitter names and the ownership check proves. DELISTED 2026-09-12: source.repo names KNICE-TECH, an organisation login freed when the organisation was renamed to MINICE-AI, which anybody can register and then release from. Registry trust in that login is withdrawn in the same change, so the listing leaves the catalogue until it is re-released from MINICE-AI/astra-chess, which is an identity change a maintainer reviews (R_IDENTITY_CHANGED). Installed copies keep working and are offered no update meanwhile; the version files stay, because they were published and signed.
